purpose: Thirty real-RTL cases for evaluating unsupported protocol, lifecycle, and operation feature extensions.
qualification_rule: A case is qualified only when pinned upstream RTL passes independently, the frozen generated TB passes pristine RTL and legal controls, all required obligations execute, all known mutants fail for the intended cause, and post-freeze held-out mutants are evaluated.

koios_vtr.project: Koios accelerator benchmarks in the SLDB-pinned VTR fork
koios_vtr.license: Per-benchmark open-source terms; per-case review required

cases.title: wishbone_pipelined_to_axi4
cases.isolation: Known AXI4 side; only the Wishbone-facing behavior is an extension.
known_mutants: drop STB while stalled
accept ACK without active CYC

cases.title: wishbone_cross_clock
cases.isolation: Identity transactions cross two clocks; operation semantics are excluded.
known_mutants: duplicate one acknowledgement after CDC
retain a cancelled request after CYC drops

cases.title: apb_cross_clock
cases.isolation: The APB state sequence is evaluated with a trivial register target.
known_mutants: enter ACCESS without a prior SETUP cycle
complete while PREADY is low

cases.title: obi_to_apb_bridge
cases.isolation: Bridge semantics are evaluated independently of an accelerator operation.
known_mutants: raise OBI rvalid before APB completion
lose the request address across APB wait states

cases.title: obi_atomic_resolver
cases.isolation: Only atomic sequencing and returned value semantics are extended.
known_mutants: forward an unsupported atomic opcode unchanged
return the post-update value instead of the required atomic result

cases.title: tilelink_ul_sram_adapter
cases.isolation: The SRAM transform is trivial; TL-UL request/response legality is the target.
known_mutants: return a mismatched D-channel source ID
accept an illegal opcode/size combination

cases.title: axi_atomic_filter
cases.isolation: Base AXI4 is tool-owned; ATOP behavior is the only extension.
known_mutants: pass a filtered ATOP downstream
omit the required response half of an atomic transaction

cases.title: axi_id_remap
cases.isolation: Base AXI handshakes remain tool-owned; ID translation is extended.
known_mutants: restore the wrong upstream ID
reuse a narrowed ID before its prior transaction retires

cases.title: axi_clock_domain_crossing
cases.isolation: Each domain uses known AXI; only cross-clock evidence and reset epochs are extended.
known_mutants: release one stale response after destination reset
reorder two same-ID requests across the CDC FIFO

cases.title: axi_stream_width_downsizer
cases.isolation: AXI-Stream legality is tool-owned; beat transformation semantics are extended.
known_mutants: map TKEEP to the wrong output lanes
assert TLAST on the first rather than final split beat

cases.title: opentitan_otbn_operational_states
cases.isolation: OTBN execution results are not evaluated; only documented state transitions are targeted.
known_mutants: skip secure wipe before returning idle
allow RESUME outside PAUSED state

cases.title: opentitan_dma_abort_and_chunking
cases.isolation: Copied payload values are secondary; abort and mode-specific retirement are targeted.
known_mutants: continue issuing writes after abort
clear GO after one chunk in persistent handshake mode

cases.title: opentitan_aes_manual_automatic_modes
cases.isolation: AES value correctness is delegated to upstream DV; mode and trigger policies are targeted.
known_mutants: start automatically while manual mode is selected
accept a new operation after entering the fatal terminal state

cases.title: opentitan_hmac_context_switch
cases.isolation: Digest math remains upstream-owned; command sequencing is targeted.
known_mutants: accept START while hashing is active
signal STOP completion before the context is readable

cases.title: opentitan_kmac_session
cases.isolation: Keccak output is not the target; session and response lifecycle are targeted.
known_mutants: emit another XOF block after DONE
return idle before CLOSE completes the session

cases.title: opentitan_csrng_command_ack
cases.isolation: Random output quality is excluded; command ownership and acknowledgment are targeted.
known_mutants: accept a second command before the first ACK
raise successful ACK after an exception status

cases.title: opentitan_flash_controller_operation
cases.isolation: Flash array content is modeled; initialization and controller operation lifecycle are targeted.
known_mutants: assert OP_DONE before the requested word count retires
accept software operation while initialization is active

cases.title: opentitan_key_manager_state_advance
cases.isolation: Derived key values are not evaluated; legal state transitions are targeted.
known_mutants: advance state after a failed operation
accept generate while the manager is disabled or invalid

cases.title: opentitan_entropy_source_health
cases.isolation: Entropy statistics are supplied by controlled fixtures; health lifecycle is targeted.
known_mutants: release entropy before startup health completion
continue normal output after a fatal health failure

cases.title: opentitan_rom_controller_boot_check
cases.isolation: Normal ROM reads are excluded; the once-per-boot checker lifecycle is targeted.
known_mutants: assert GOOD before all ROM words are checked
assert GOOD after a digest mismatch

cases.title: koios_self_attention_layer
cases.isolation: Known linear primitives are reused; the self-attention composition is extended.
known_mutants: swap the key and value operands
omit score scaling before softmax

cases.title: koios_binary_neural_network
cases.isolation: Lifecycle and HLS transport are fixed; binary dense-layer semantics are extended.
known_mutants: interpret one binary weight bit with the opposite sign
bypass one binary dense layer

cases.title: koios_convolution_layer
cases.isolation: Known matrix multiplication is reused; convolution lowering and spatial semantics are extended.
known_mutants: use the wrong padding offset
omit one partial-product tile from accumulation

cases.title: koios_elementwise_layer
cases.isolation: Scalar operators are known; mode selection, broadcasting, and lane mapping are extended.
known_mutants: broadcast the scalar to the wrong lane
execute addition when multiplication is selected

cases.title: koios_gemm_layer
cases.isolation: GEMM arithmetic is tool-owned; banked memory mapping and fixed schedule are extended.
known_mutants: read one B bank from the wrong address
retire the final output row one cycle early

cases.title: koios_lenet
cases.isolation: Known primitives are reused; the complete LeNet graph and fixed-point boundaries are extended.
known_mutants: skip one fixed-point cast
route one layer output to the wrong successor

cases.title: koios_lstm
cases.isolation: Known linear primitives are reused; recurrent state and gate composition are extended.
known_mutants: swap input and forget gates
retain the previous hidden state instead of committing the new state

cases.title: koios_reduction_layer
cases.isolation: Scalar operators are known; tree reduction and operator-specific identity are extended.
known_mutants: drop the final reduction lane
use zero identity for a maximum reduction

cases.title: koios_softmax
cases.isolation: Vector transport is fixed; stable fixed-point softmax semantics are extended.
known_mutants: subtract the wrong maximum value
normalize with the unrounded reciprocal

cases.title: koios_sparse_matrix_vector
cases.isolation: MAC arithmetic is reused; CISR traversal and row ownership are extended.
known_mutants: associate one value with the next sparse index
fail to reset accumulation at a row boundary
